name: primer-kit
description: Primer implementation kit: everything needed to build GitHub Primer React components on any renderer. All facts derive from Primer React at one release of primer/react, the @primer/primitives tokens and @primer/octicons icons at pinned versions, and primer.style.
readOrder: foundations.json: system rules every spec assumes (token tiers and naming, the 14 themes, colour roles and pairing, the type ramp, radii and borders, spacing, the shadow ramp and z-index, states, focus, motion, control sizes and density, breakpoints, overlays, icons).
tokens/primer.resolved.json: every token value per theme, keyed by the CSS custom property Primer reads (--fgColor-default). Look up any path a spec names here.

components/<id>.json: one spec per component. Build from its tokenGroups plus its layout, states and behaviour rules; its values carry the sizes Primer hard-codes; read its notes before trusting a token.

conventions.tokenPaths: Strings matching ^--[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9-]*$ are token paths in tokens/primer.resolved.json; every one in this kit is checked to exist.
conventions.sources: source fields cite Primer React files as <Name>.module.css:lines, <Name>.tsx:lines or <Name>.docs.json under source/react, mixins under source/mixins, DESIGN_TOKENS_GUIDE.md, or primer:<slug> for primer.style/product/components.
conventions.units: px for dimensions, ms for durations; shadows are layers of {x, y, blur, spread, color, inset}; there are no springs.

components.name: ActionBar
components.summary: A single-row toolbar of invisible IconButtons and Buttons, optionally split by dividers and groups, that moves whatever does not fit into a trailing "More items" menu. Choose it for a toolbar that must survive narrow containers; choose ButtonGroup for a fixed cluster of joined buttons.

components.name: ActionList
components.summary: A vertical list of rows, each an action, a link or a selectable option, with optional leading and trailing visuals, descriptions, groups and dividers. Use it bare for a list of actions or links on a page; ActionMenu, SelectPanel and Autocomplete wrap it and give it menu or listbox semantics, a selection model and keyboard focus management.

components.name: ActionMenu
components.summary: A button that opens a floating menu of actions (an ActionList with menu semantics), optionally with single or multiple selection and nested submenus. Choose it for a short list of commands or a small set of options; choose SelectPanel when the list needs filtering, many selections or a confirm step.

components.name: AnchoredOverlay
components.summary: An Overlay that opens from a trigger and positions itself against it: on a chosen side and alignment, offset 4px, flipping to another side and alignment when it would be clipped, then clamped into bounds. Use it for menus, pickers and any non-modal floating panel tied to a control; use popover for a static callout with a caret and tooltip for hover text.

components.name: Autocomplete
components.summary: A text input that suggests matching options in a listbox below it as the user types, with inline completion of the highlighted option, single or multiple selection, and an optional add-new item. Choose it when the field is the text input itself (with TextInputWithTokens for multiple values); choose SelectPanel when choosing happens in a panel opened from a button.

components.name: Avatar
components.summary: A user's or organisation's image, round for people and rounded-square for organisations, bots and apps. Use AvatarStack for several and SkeletonAvatar while the image's data loads.

components.name: AvatarStack
components.summary: Up to five overlapping avatars that represent a group (assignees, contributors) and fan out on hover or focus to show them all. Use it where space allows one avatar's height and a short run of width.

components.name: Banner
components.summary: A bordered, tinted message block that highlights page- or section-level information (critical, warning, success, info, upsell) with an icon, a title, an optional description and up to two actions, optionally dismissible. Choose it over InlineMessage when the message stands on its own as a landmark; choose InlineMessage for a one-line status next to the thing it describes.

components.name: Blankslate
components.summary: A centred empty state: an optional muted icon, a heading, a muted description and up to two actions (a primary Button and a secondary Link). Use it where a list, table or page has nothing to show yet, or to explain a missing feature; it is not a message about an event (use Banner).

components.name: BranchName
components.summary: A git branch name set in monospace on a pale accent chip, linking to the branch by default. Choose it wherever a branch is named in running UI; it is not a Label or Token and has no remove or select behaviour.

components.name: Button
components.summary: A labelled action. Choose emphasis by variant (primary for the one main action on a surface, default for the rest, danger for destructive actions, invisible for low-emphasis actions in dense UI, link for an action that reads as text), size by the density around it. A button with an href is a LinkButton: the same look, navigating instead of acting.

components.name: ButtonGroup
components.summary: Joins related Buttons and IconButtons into one segmented strip whose borders touch. Choose it for a split button or a cluster of peer actions; choose ActionBar when the row must collapse into an overflow menu, and SegmentedControl when exactly one option is selected.

components.name: Card
components.summary: A bordered, raised box summarising one item: an icon or edge-to-edge image on top, a heading and description, a metadata row, and one corner action. Choose it for grids or lists of browsable items; use a plain bordered box for arbitrary grouped content.

components.name: Checkbox
components.summary: A 16px box that toggles an independent on/off choice, with an indeterminate (mixed) state for a parent of partly checked children. Choose ToggleSwitch for a setting that applies immediately and Radio for one of several exclusive options; pair it with a FormControl label.

components.name: CheckboxGroup
components.summary: A labelled set of related checkboxes, each in its own FormControl, with one caption and one validation message for the whole set and an onChange that reports every checked value. Choose RadioGroup when only one option may be chosen.

components.name: CircleBadge
components.summary: A large white disc with a soft shadow that frames a logo or octicon, used to connect third-party services visually. Do not choose it for new work.

components.name: ConfirmationDialog
components.summary: A Dialog that asks one question and offers exactly two buttons, cancel and confirm, and reports which closed it. Use it to confirm an action, especially a destructive one; use dialog when the task needs a form or more than two choices.

components.name: CounterLabel
components.summary: A small pill showing a count next to a tab, button or heading. Choose secondary (the default) for ordinary counts and primary for one that needs attention; inside a Button, the button supplies the colours.

components.name: DataTable
components.summary: A grid table of rows built from a column definition list: per-column width rules, start or end alignment, row headers, client-side or external sorting, optional row groups, three cell densities, a loading skeleton, and a container with title, subtitle, actions and a pagination footer. Choose it for tabular records the user scans and sorts; choose an ActionList or a plain list for single-column items.

components.name: Details
components.summary: A disclosure: a summary that toggles the visibility of the content after it. Use it for show-more sections and simple native-feeling dropdowns; use anchored-overlay for menus that must float, position and trap focus.

components.name: Dialog
components.summary: A modal window over a dimming backdrop, with a title bar and close button, a scrolling body and an optional row of footer buttons; focus is trapped inside and the page behind stops scrolling. Use it for short tasks and decisions that block the page; use confirmation-dialog for a plain yes/no, anchored-overlay for non-modal panels.

components.name: FormControl
components.summary: Pairs one input with its label, caption and validation message, and lays them out vertically for text-like inputs or horizontally (box, then label) for a checkbox or radio. Use it around every TextInput, Textarea, Select, Checkbox and Radio; group checkboxes or radios with CheckboxGroup or RadioGroup.

components.name: Header
components.summary: GitHub's dark global bar: a horizontal row of items (logo link, navigation links, a full-width spacer item, avatar) on the header background. Choose it for an app-wide top bar; choose page-header for a page's own title block.

components.name: Heading
components.summary: A section heading: an h1-h6 element set in one of the title presets. Choose the element for the document outline and the variant for the visual weight, independently; use Text for running copy.

components.name: IconButton
components.summary: A square button whose only content is an icon, labelled by a tooltip that shows its accessible name. Choose it over Button in toolbars and dense rows where the icon is unambiguous; choose Button when the action needs words to be understood.

components.name: InlineMessage
components.summary: A short status line, an icon and coloured text, placed next to the thing it describes (a form field, a row, a section). Choose it over Banner when the message is part of the flow rather than a standalone landmark; it has no background, border, title or actions.

components.name: IssueLabel
components.summary: A filled pill for a GitHub issue label in one of 19 named label hues, or in an arbitrary hex colour with black or white text. Choose it for user-defined labels; choose Label for fixed metadata and Token or IssueLabelToken when the label is removable.

components.name: KeybindingHint
components.summary: A visual, platform-aware rendering of a keyboard shortcut: one bordered key cap per chord, in symbols (condensed) or words (full), with spoken names for assistive technology. It only displays a shortcut; it binds nothing.

components.name: Label
components.summary: A small outlined pill of text that adds metadata or a status to an object (Beta, Private, Required). Choose it over StateLabel when the label is not the object's open/closed state, over Token when the user cannot select or remove it, and over IssueLabel for user-defined colours.

components.name: LabelGroup
components.summary: A row of Labels, Tokens or IssueLabels that either wraps freely or truncates to a count or to the available width, collapsing the rest behind a "+N" button that expands them inline or in an overlay. Use it for any list of labels attached to one object.

components.name: Link
components.summary: Inline navigational text in the accent colour, underlined on hover (or always, inside prose, when the user asks for link underlines). Choose it to navigate; choose Button with variant link for an action that should look like text.

components.name: Overlay
components.summary: A floating, elevated surface placed at explicit coordinates, with Escape, outside-press and focus-on-open/return-on-close behaviour built in. Build it once as the base layer; choose anchored-overlay when the surface hangs off a trigger, dialog when it is modal with a backdrop.

components.name: PageHeader
components.summary: The top of a page or view: a title with optional leading and trailing visuals, actions beside it, a leading back action, breadcrumbs, a description and local navigation below, and a context area (parent link, context bar, context actions) above it that by default appears only at narrow widths. Choose it for a page's own heading block; choose header for GitHub's global site bar.

components.name: PageLayout
components.summary: The page frame: an optional header, a content region with one side pane, an optional footer, and an optional full-height sidebar outside them, with spacing, dividers, pane width and pane position that change at viewport ranges. Choose it for a whole page with a centred, width-capped container; choose split-page-layout for full-bleed, edge-to-edge panes.

components.name: Popover
components.summary: A padded card with a caret pointing at the thing it explains, placed by the caller. Use it for a non-modal callout tied to a spot on the page (onboarding, feature discovery); use anchored-overlay for menus and pickers that open from a control, tooltip for short hover text.

components.name: ProgressBar
components.summary: A thin horizontal bar showing determinate progress, either one fill or several coloured segments (ProgressBar.Item) for a breakdown such as language shares. Use Spinner when progress is unknown.

components.name: Radio
components.summary: A 16px circle for one choice among mutually exclusive options sharing a name. Use it inside a RadioGroup with a FormControl per option; choose Checkbox for independent choices and SegmentedControl for a compact view switch.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.summary: A labelled set of mutually exclusive Radio options, each in its own FormControl, sharing one name, one caption and one validation message, reporting the chosen value. Choose CheckboxGroup for multiple choices, Select for a long list, SegmentedControl for a compact view switch.

components.name: RelativeTime
components.summary: Inline text that renders a timestamp relative to now ("3 hours ago", "in 2 days") or as a short localised date past a threshold, with the precise date in a hover title. Use it for activity times in lists and timelines; show the full date instead where users must read it reliably.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.summary: A row of two to five mutually exclusive buttons in a track, one always selected, for switching how content is viewed (list or grid, preview or source). Choose UnderlineNav or tabs for navigation between pages, RadioGroup for a form choice, ToggleSwitch for on/off.

components.name: Select
components.summary: A single choice from a short fixed list, drawn as TextInput's well with an up-down arrow and opening the platform's native option list. Choose it for plain-text options in a form; choose ActionMenu or SelectPanel for rich items, filtering or multiple selection.

components.name: SelectPanel
components.summary: A button that opens an anchored (or modal) dialog holding a filter input above a selectable list, for choosing one or many items from a long or remote set. Choose it over ActionMenu when users need to filter, select several items, or confirm a choice; choose Autocomplete when the input itself is the field.

components.name: SkeletonAvatar
components.summary: A shimmering placeholder of an Avatar's exact size and shape, shown while the avatar's data loads. Pair it with SkeletonText for a loading list row.

components.name: SkeletonBox
components.summary: A muted rounded rectangle that stands in for content of known shape while it loads, shimmering unless the user prefers reduced motion. Use SkeletonText for text lines and SkeletonAvatar for avatars; use Spinner when the shape is unknown.

components.name: SkeletonText
components.summary: Placeholder bars the height of a text style's glyphs, spaced to that style's line height, standing in for one or more lines of text while it loads. Use SkeletonBox for non-text shapes.

components.name: Spinner
components.summary: An indeterminate loading indicator: a rotating quarter arc over a faint ring. Use it when the wait has no known length; use ProgressBar when progress is measurable and skeletons when the shape of the coming content is known.

components.name: SplitPageLayout
components.summary: A full-bleed page frame: a sticky start pane edge-to-edge against the page, a line divider, and padded content, with lined header and footer. Choose it for settings and list-detail pages that fill the window; choose page-layout for a centred, width-capped page with gaps around the pane.

components.name: Stack
components.summary: A one-dimensional layout primitive: children in a row or column with a gap from the stack spacing scale, cross-axis alignment, main-axis distribution, optional wrapping and padding, each settable per viewport range. Choose it for arranging siblings; choose page-layout for page regions.

components.name: StateLabel
components.summary: A filled pill with an octicon that states an issue's, pull request's or alert's lifecycle state (Open, Closed, Merged, Draft...). Choose it over Label only for that state; the status picks both colour and icon.

components.name: Text
components.summary: A run of body text with optional size (body small, medium, large), weight and white-space presets. Use it for copy and labels inside other layouts; use Heading for titles and Truncate to clip one line.

components.name: TextInput
components.summary: A single-line text field in a bordered well, with optional leading and trailing visuals, an inline trailing action, a loading spinner and a character counter. Choose Textarea for multi-line text and Select for a fixed list; wrap it in a FormControl for its label, caption and validation message.

components.name: TextInputWithTokens
components.summary: A text input that shows the values already chosen as removable tokens (pills) inline before the caret, wrapping onto new lines as they grow. Use it as the input of a multi-select Autocomplete; for a single value use a plain TextInput.

components.name: Textarea
components.summary: A multi-line text field in the same well as TextInput, resizable by the user and optionally growing with its content, with an optional character counter. Choose TextInput for one line; wrap it in a FormControl for label, caption and validation.

components.name: Timeline
components.summary: A vertical sequence of events joined by a 2px line: each item has a round badge (an icon on a coloured disc) on the line, body text beside it, optional trailing actions and an optional avatar in the left gutter; a break marks a gap in time. Use it for activity feeds and histories; use a plain list when the items are not ordered in time.

components.name: ToggleSwitch
components.summary: An on/off switch for a setting that takes effect immediately, with a visible 'On'/'Off' status label beside the track. Choose Checkbox when the choice is submitted later with a form; label it with a visible element whose id the switch names.

components.name: Token
components.summary: A compact pill for one selected value (a user, a label, a filter) that may be clickable, selectable and removable. Choose it over Label when the user acts on the value; use IssueLabelToken, its sibling, when the value is a GitHub label with an arbitrary colour.

components.name: Tooltip
components.summary: A small dark label that appears beside an interactive element on hover (after a short delay) or keyboard focus, either naming the element (type label) or adding a description to it. Use it for icon-only controls and brief supplementary text; never put interactive content in it, and prefer visible text where space allows.

components.name: TopicTag
components.summary: A blue pill linking to a repository topic. It is a link by default; use TopicTag.Group to lay several out. Choose Label for non-navigating metadata.

components.name: Truncate
components.summary: Clips one line of text to a maximum width with an ellipsis and shows the full text in a native tooltip; optionally expands to full width on hover. Use it only where wrapping or more room is impossible, and never around focusable content.
